mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fulfillments (id, order_id, target_player_uid, operator_id, claimed_at, proof_object_key, delivery_note, reviewed_at, status, attempts, delivered_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{targetPlayerUid}, #{operatorId}, #{claimedAt}, #{proofObjectKey}, #{deliveryNote}, #{reviewedAt}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{deliveredAt}, #{lastError}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE fulfillments SET operator_id = #{operatorId}, claimed_at = #{claimedAt}, status = 'CLAIMED', attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'MANUAL_PENDING'

UPDATE fulfillments SET proof_object_key = #{proofObjectKey}, delivery_note = #{deliveryNote}, status = 'AWAITING_REVIEW', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND operator_id = #{operatorId} AND status = 'CLAIMED'

UPDATE fulfillments SET operator_id = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, proof_object_key = NULL, delivery_note = NULL, reviewed_at = NULL, delivered_at = NULL, last_error = #{reason}, status = 'MANUAL_PENDING', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
